name: Die block tile
style: Parametric silicon IP-block die tile, 6.2 mm square default, 0.4 mm thick; tensor (MAC array), sram (bit-cell stripes), noc (routing grid), hbmPhy (edge bump rows), io (pad ring); faint emissive tint per type; four named snap pins.
summary: Parametric die block tile (tensor, sram, noc, hbmPhy, io): silicon body, type-specific surface pattern, emissive tint, named snap pin sockets.
